goal: Provide a CLI reset path for metrics.<phase>.gateRetry and surface remaining retry budget before gate runs, so users can recover from ESCALATE_RETRY_EXHAUSTED without editing flow.json by hand.
background: run-gate.js tracks gateRetry for task-impl/integration via countGateRetry and raises ESCALATE_RETRY_EXHAUSTED at config.flow.retry.max (default 3). Today the only recovery is manually appending a reset metric to flow.json — encountered during spec 207.

in: New subcommand `sdd-forge flow set gate-retry reset <phase> --yes`
Warning line printed at the start of executeDiffBasedGate in run-gate.js
Unit tests for the new command

constraints: Node.js built-ins only; no new npm deps
Reuse flowManager.appendMetric; do not touch flow.json directly
design_principles: Command has a single append side effect
--yes is a hard requirement; no env-var override
Warning is stderr-only; does not alter JSON envelope

modules.text: src/flow/lib/run-gate.js — warnGateRetryBudget helper and call site in executeDiffBasedGate

data_flow.text: Command calls flowManager.appendMetric({phase, counter: 'gateRetry', delta: 0, reset: true})

decisions.text: Shape is `set gate-retry <action> <phase>` to leave room for future actions
Warning written to stderr, consistent with existing diagnostic output

requirements.desc: `sdd-forge flow set gate-retry reset <phase> --yes` appends exactly one metric entry {phase, counter: 'gateRetry', delta: 0, reset: true} via flowManager.appendMetric.
Reject phase values not in RETRY_TRACKED_PHASES (task-impl, integration) with a clear error.
Reject invocations without --yes, print current gateRetry count for the requested phase to stderr, and exit non-zero.
Reject unknown action values (anything other than 'reset') with a clear error.
After successful reset, countGateRetry(state.metrics, phase) returns 0 until a subsequent FAIL increments it.

executeDiffBasedGate writes a one-line warning to stderr: `[sdd-forge] gate retry: <used>/<max> used (<remaining> remaining) for phase "<phase>"` before assertRetryBelowMax runs. Must not affect JSON envelope or gate result.
registry.js exposes set.gate-retry with args.positional: ['action','phase'], args.flags: ['--yes'], a help string, and requiresFlow: true.

acceptance_criteria: Unit test: successful reset appends the expected metric entry
Unit test: missing --yes throws and current count is reported
Unit test: countGateRetry returns 0 after reset
Registry lookup for set.gate-retry returns expected shape
Manual: flow run gate prints the warning line to stderr

clarifications.q: Warning for every gate phase or diff-based only?
Can --yes be replaced by interactive confirmation?
clarifications.a: No. CLI is invoked from AI/skill chains without interactive stdin.

alternatives_considered.reason: Rejected — loses the audit trail of reset intent
Rejected — undocumented procedure, no audit entry
Already in place; does not solve exhaustion case
